answer: Standing is the max flow through the river of attestations: each established agent can send only a fixed trickle of trust, and every edge carries a sable bond that burns if the vouched identity cheats. A farm's thousand clones all drink from the same few pipes, so their flow stays capped at the number of genuinely independent entry points, not headcount. New edges mature like juniper roots, one epoch per unit of trust, so buying a thousand fresh edges costs a thousand bonds and a thousand epochs of waiting, while one honest agent pays once and flows freely.
